<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/../src/Accessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/JsonAccessor.php';

use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\EnvAccessor;
use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\JsonAccessor;

$failures = 0;
function check(string $name, bool $ok): void
{
    global $failures;
    echo ($ok ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") . $name . "\n";
    if (!$ok) {
        $failures++;
    }
}

$env = new EnvAccessor("HOST=localhost\nPORT=3000\n");
check('reads KEY=value lines', $env->get('HOST') === 'localhost' && $env->get('PORT') === '3000');

$env = new EnvAccessor("# a comment\n\nKEY=value\n");
check('skips blank lines and comments', $env->all() === ['KEY' => 'value']);

$env = new EnvAccessor("A=\"one two\"\nB='three'\n");
check('strips one pair of matching quotes', $env->get('A') === 'one two' && $env->get('B') === 'three');

$env = new EnvAccessor('KEY=value');
check('answers the fallback for a key that is not there', $env->get('MISSING', 'none') === 'none' && $env->has('KEY') && !$env->has('MISSING'));

$json = new JsonAccessor('{"name":"x","count":3}');
check('json keeps the string values of an object', $json->all() === ['name' => 'x']);

exit($failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

content.text: Everything passes in both packages. Next I'll record the one choice here that someone could later question, which is how the prefix is matched.

input.title: EnvAccessor strips a leading `export` word (space or tab after it) from a line, in both packages
input.rationale: A line written `export KEY=value` (a shell habit) is read as `KEY=value`: the key is `KEY`. The prefix is removed with `^export[ \t]+` after the blank/comment check and before the `=` split, in `packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts` and `packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php` in the same change, per ADR-1. `export` must be a word of its own followed by at least one space or tab, so `export=1`, `exported=2` and `export_path=3` keep their keys; `export NOEQUALS` is still skipped for having no `=`; `# export X=1` is still a comment. Matching is case-sensitive, as in a shell. Side effect of "exactly as if the prefix were not there": `export =v` used to give key `export` and is now skipped, like `=v`. Tests for these cases are in both packages.
input.alternatives: `^export\s+`: rejected, JS `\s` matches Unicode spaces and PCRE without /u only ASCII ones, so the two packages would disagree on a line with e.g. a no-break space; `[ \t]` is the same in both. Strip only the literal string `export ` (one space): rejected, `export<TAB>KEY=v` and `export   KEY=v` are valid shell and would give a wrong key or rely on the later trim. Parse with a shell-aware tokenizer or accept `declare -x`, `set -a`: rejected, beyond the request and against the repo's plain, standard-library-only rule. Case-insensitive `EXPORT`: rejected, a shell does not accept it. Change JS only, as the request was worded: rejected, ADR-1 requires the pair to move together and the gap is the defect.

content.text:
`EnvAccessor` now reads `export KEY=value` as `KEY=value`, and I made the same change in the PHP package. Both test suites pass (9 JS tests, 8 PHP checks). I haven't committed anything.

**Why PHP changed too:** you only mentioned JS, but ADR-1 requires a behavior change in one package to be made in the other in the same PR. I made the change in both so the two don't diverge. If you want JS alone, revert the two PHP files, though that breaks ADR-1.

**The change:**
- **Code:** a line has its leading `export` word and the spaces or tabs after it removed before the `=` split. This happens after the blank-line and `#` comment check. The code is in `packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts` and `packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php`, and I updated the doc comment in both.
- **Boundaries:**
  - `export=1`, `exported=2` and `export_path=3` keep their keys.
  - `export NOEQUALS` is still skipped.
  - `# export X=1` is still a comment.
  - Matching is case-sensitive, as in a shell.
- **Whitespace:** I used `[ \t]+` rather than `\s+`. JS `\s` matches Unicode spaces and PHP's doesn't, so `\s+` would have made the packages disagree.
- **Tests:** three new cases in `packages/js/tests/env-accessor.test.ts`, and the same three in `packages/php/tests/run.php`. They cover the basic `export` line, quoted values with extra spaces or a tab, and the lines above that must not be treated as a prefix.

**One behavior change on an odd input:** `export =v` used to give the key `export`. It is now skipped, like `=v`, which follows from "exactly as if the prefix were not there".

**Verification:**
- **JS:** `npm test --workspace packages/js` passes.
- **PHP:** `php packages/php/tests/run.php` passes.
- **Parity scripts:** I didn't run `test:parity` separately. In both packages it runs the same command as `test`.

**Record:** I recorded this as ADR-2 in `.mnema/`, with the alternatives I turned down. It is `proposed` and nobody has accepted it. I didn't link it to any path. ADR-1's address list also includes `parity-vectors.json`, which doesn't exist in this repo. That file is from another repo, so the address is stale here.

`git status` shows new `.mnema/keys/…pub` and `.mnema/tails/…` files, written when this session first recorded something. The hook says this session's key founded a new identity, `mnid:a4b8bfa7`, next to the existing `mnid:3b2c3f61`. If that identity is you on another machine, the hook's output has the `mnema key request --anchor mnid:3b2c3f61` steps to fix it. Otherwise there's nothing to do. Commit `.mnema/` together with the four code files.
